mentions.name: Skyviz
mentions.description: This app visualizes paragliding flight tracks, letting users view and analyze their paragliding flights with 3D visualization. It began as a personal tool and is now being developed as a product.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a paragliding track visualizer: https://skyviz.io - I started it just for myself, then it kind of got out of control, and now I'm spending wayyy to much time on it
